name: Dark Star Vessel
designation_status: Union operational designation; true identity and classification unknown.
narrative_significance: Concealed vessel or containment architecture at the center of the Dark Star incident.
canon_observations: Was concealed within or behind the mining-vessel profile presented as M.V. Carpathia.
Used external mining structure and sensor shaping to produce a false internal profile.
Displayed segmented internal signal and material domains of approximately thirty-seven meters in observed areas.
Contained suspended captives from multiple populations and eras, including an older Marshal prisoner.
Its hull or internal material could reshape passages, isolate signals, animate armor and bodies, and imitate observed systems.
Contained a central phenomenon operationally designated the dark star.
Reacted to the Third Silence artifact and alternating Sentinel/Ranger field frequencies.
Was boarded by the Third Measure crew, Kestrel Detachment, and Shadow Fleet personnel.
staging_interpretations: The vessel is definitively a prison.
The captives function as intentional containment locks.
The vessel possesses a unified consciousness.
The dark star is a living entity.
The vessel was created by the Shadow Fleet.
The apparent thirty-seven-meter segmentation is globally uniform.
carpathia_boundary: M.V. Carpathia is the observed mining-vessel identity and external presentation. It is not yet established whether Carpathia was an independent ship, a constructed shell, a captured vessel, or a false registry attached to the concealed architecture.
